# @react-native/prod-middleware

![npm package](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@react-native/prod-middleware?color=brightgreen&label=npm%20package)

prod server middleware supporting core React Native production features. This package is preconfigured in all React Native projects.

## Usage

Middleware can be attached to a prod server (e.g. [Metro](https://facebook.github.io/metro/docs/getting-started)) using the `createprodMiddleware` API.

```js
import { createprodMiddleware } from '@react-native/prod-middleware';

function myprodServerImpl(args) {
  ...

  const {middleware, websocketEndpoints} = createprodMiddleware({
    projectRoot: metroConfig.projectRoot,
    serverBaseUrl: `http://${args.host}:${args.port}`,
    logger,
  });

  await Metro.runServer(metroConfig, {
    host: args.host,
    ...,
    unstable_extraMiddleware: [
      middleware,
      // Optionally extend with additional HTTP middleware
    ],
    websocketEndpoints: {
      ...websocketEndpoints,
      // Optionally extend with additional WebSocket endpoints
    },
  });
}
```

## Included middleware

`@react-native/prod-middleware` is designed for integrators such as [`@expo/prod-server`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@expo/prod-server) and [`@react-native/community-cli-plugin`](https://github.com/facebook/react-native/tree/main/packages/community-cli-plugin). It provides a common default implementation for core React Native prod server responsibilities.

We intend to keep this to a narrow set of functionality, based around:

- **Debugging** — The [Chrome prodTools protocol (CDP)](https://chromeprodtools.github.io/prodtools-protocol/) endpoints supported by React Native, including the Inspector Proxy, which facilitates connections with multiple prodices.
- **prod actions** — Endpoints implementing core [prod Menu](https://reactnative.prod/docs/debugging#accessing-the-prod-menu) actions, e.g. reloading the app, opening the debugger frontend.

### HTTP endpoints

<small>`prodMiddlewareAPI.middleware`</small>

These are exposed as a [`connect`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/connect) middleware handler, assignable to `Metro.runServer` or other compatible HTTP servers.

#### GET `/json/list`, `/json` ([CDP](https://chromeprodtools.github.io/prodtools-protocol/#endpoints))

Returns the list of available WebSocket targets for all connected React Native app sessions.

#### GET `/json/version` ([CDP](https://chromeprodtools.github.io/prodtools-protocol/#endpoints))

Returns version metadata used by Chrome prodTools.

#### GET `/debugger-frontend`

Subpaths of this endpoint are reserved to serve the JavaScript debugger frontend.

#### POST `/open-debugger`

Open the JavaScript debugger for a given CDP target. Must be provided with one of the following query params:

- `prodice`‌ — An ID unique to a combination of prodice and app, stable across installs. Implemented by `getInspectorprodiceId` on each native platform.
- `target` — The target page ID as returned by `/json/list` for the current prod server session.
- `appId` (deprecated, legacy only) — The application bundle identifier to match (non-unique across multiple connected prodices). This param will only match legacy Hermes debugger targets.

<details>
<summary>Example</summary>

    curl -X POST 'http://localhost:8081/open-debugger?target=<targetId>'
</details>

### WebSocket endpoints

<small>`prodMiddlewareAPI.websocketEndpoints`</small>

#### `/inspector/prodice`

WebSocket handler for registering prodice connections.

#### `/inspector/debug`

WebSocket handler that proxies CDP messages to/from the corresponding prodice.

## Contributing

Changes to this package can be made locally and tested against the `rn-tester` app, per the [Contributing guide](https://reactnative.prod/contributing/overview#contributing-code). During production, this package is automatically run from source with no build step.
